Evanto uses the cursor and keyboard in the app you choose for a typed Mac task.
Evanto uses the selected display or window for screenshots you send, Clean Share, and recordings you save.
Evanto transcribes audio playing on your Mac when Mac audio is on.
Evanto transcribes nearby speech during a live session when the microphone is on.
Evanto converts live audio to text on this Mac so it can answer spoken questions.
